title: Ishmael
summary: Son of Abraham in Hales’s synopsis. No earlier person record of Ishmael was in the data.
description: Added from the Hales import. Display only. Hales prints his own B.C. years in the synopsis and in Table XI. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person’s birth, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Hales is display-only).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the birth entry (Ishmael 2067). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

birth.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxiii
